question: Which movie has been selected as India's official entry to the Oscars 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jallikattu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jallikattu **__movie was selected as India's official entry to the Oscars 2021.
 
• Jallikattu is a Malayalam film directed by Lijo Jose Pellissery.
 
• It was supposed to compete in the Best International Feature Film category. However, it didn’t make it to the final nomination.
 
• The plot of the movie follows a bull that escapes from a slaughterhouse in a hilly remote village and the entire village men gathering to hunt down the animal.
 
• Lijo received the Best Director trophy at the 50th International Film Festival of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Academy Awards, popularly known as the Oscars, are annually given by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
 
• These awards are international recognition of excellence in cinematic achievements.
